definitions.explanation: The state of having an empty stomach and feeling hungry. A more formal or objective way to describe hunger compared to the casual お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まま→〜まま：02007_mama⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to study on an empty stomach.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let's eat something to satisfy our hunger.

examples.japanese: {空腹|くうふく}⟦{時|じ}→〜時：03094_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}まないで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't take this medicine on an empty stomach.
